config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Twinkle`.

config_entries.label: Progress Interval
config_entries.description: The interval with which to progress the effect. This affects the duration of a twinkle animation. Defaults to `4ms`.

config_entries.label: Twinkle Probability
config_entries.description: The percentage with which, at any time step, a randomly-chosen LED should start its twinkle animation.
